item.title: Adai Caddo Indians inducted into the Sons of the American Revolution
item.description: Adai Caddo citizens Robert and Tristan Brevelle were inducted into the National Society of the Sons of the American Revolution (SAR) on February. 14 at Fort St. Jean Baptiste. The SAR honors Revolutionary War patriot ancestors by promoting patriotism, community service, American history, and inspiring future generations about the founding principles of our country. item.description: The Natchitoches Historic District Development Commission approved financial reports and received updates on public art installations, downtown programming and upcoming community events during its Feb. 19 meeting. item.title: St. Anne’s Church Fish Fry in Natchez: February 20
item.description: St. Anne’s Church in Old River will host a fish fry on Friday, Feb. 20 from 5-8 PM. The church is located at 3659 Old River Road.
